item.title: Staff Sgt. Rampersad, 28, Who Always Wanted to Serve, Laid to Rest
item.description: Staff Sgt. Angel S. Rampersad is among several service members recently killed in the Iran conflict. Her family says she knew from a young age she wanted to serve.

item.title: Lebanese Who Fled Israeli Invasion Return to See What Remains
item.description: Residents of Nabatiyeh in southern Lebanon have faced past wars, but the latest conflict with Israel is testing their endurance.

item.title: Death toll in Spain border crisis reaches 67 as tens of thousands cross back into Morocco
item.description: The death toll in Spain's Ceuta border crisis with Morocco has risen to 67, including victims who drowned or died in a stampede.

item.title: More than 25,000 children lose previous legal protections as federal contract ends
item.description: Thousands of unaccompanied immigrant children are losing legal representation after the federal contract funding their legal access expired Friday.
